title: Battle of Borgo
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Borgo", at revision 1370108048, opens: "The Battle of Borgo was a military engagement fought between the forces of Corsica and France forces over control of the town of Borgo, during the French conquest of Corsica." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2888176, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1768 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
